ammonia.reason: Protein deamination by Brevibacterium linens smear during 3-6 week wash-ripening

animal_barnyard.reason: p-cresol and indole from Brevibacterium / smear metabolism of tyrosine and tryptophan

bitter.reason: Hydrophobic peptides from rennet and starter proteolysis in young smear cheese

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti or methyl ketone blue-mold pathway used

browning.reason: Moderate lactose and lysine residue for Maillard on heating in 4-week cheese

buttery.reason: Diacetyl and acetoin from lactococcal citrate fermentation

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Butanoic and hexanoic acids from starter and smear lipolysis

creaminess.reason: High moisture ~43% and 45% FDM fat giving smooth smear-ripened paste

crumbliness.reason: Elastic washed-rind paste with small holes, not dry-granular

firmness.reason: Semi-hard pressed body ripened 3-6 weeks, sliceable but yielding

floral_honey.reason: Low 2-phenylethanol and phenylacetaldehyde from phenylalanine catabolism

fruity.reason: Ethyl butanoate and ethyl hexanoate from smear esterification of free fatty acids

goaty.reason: Cow milk low in branched caprylic acids, no goat-milk 4-methyloctanoic note

malty_nutty.reason: Strecker 2- and 3-methylbutanal from leucine/isoleucine during early proteolysis

melt.reason: pH ~5.9 intact rennet casein network flows well when heated

mushroom_earthy.reason: Limited 1-octen-3-ol from surface flora, no bloomy rind

oil_off.reason: 26% fat semi-hard emulsion releases moderate free oil on melting

sour_vinegar.reason: Lactic and acetic acids from mesophilic starter and brine wash

stretch.reason: Non-pasta-filata rennet curd, flows but does not form long strings

sulfur_cooked.reason: Low methanethiol and dimethyl sulfide from smear methionine catabolism

sweet.reason: Residual lactose and sweet amino acids proline and alanine, mild smear

umami.reason: Glutamate released by starter and Brevibacterium proteolysis
